context: A mom and her young son share a quiet snack moment
purpose: Teach: もっぱら/それなのに/いやぁ/おもっ/しょっちゅう/時折/一口/出番

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、一口だけちょうだい!
lines.style: Eager small child reaching toward mother's plate

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いやぁ、翔はおやつになると、しょっちゅう手が伸びてくるね。
lines.en: Goodness, whenever snack time comes, your hand keeps reaching over.
lines.style: Warm teasing mother with a gentle laughing smile

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: だってぼく、おやつの出番が来るのを朝からずっと待ってたんだもん!
lines.en: Because I've been waiting since morning for snack time to come!
lines.style: Bright cheerful child bouncing with sparkling enthusiasm

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、ママも時折おばあちゃんと一緒に食べたおやつを思い出すよ。
lines.en: Hehe, I sometimes remember snacks shared with Grandma too.
lines.style: Soft nostalgic mother voice drifting gently into memory

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくね、ママのクッキーが世界で一番好きっておもってた!
lines.en: You know, I've always thought your cookies are the best in the world!
lines.style: Earnest declaration from a proud little boy beaming

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: それなのにこの前、パパのプリンも一番だって言ってたでしょ?
lines.en: And yet last time you said Dad's pudding was the best too?
lines.style: Playfully catching child in a sweet little contradiction

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: えへへ、バレた…どっちももっぱら一番なの!
lines.en: Heheh, you caught me... both of them are totally number one!
lines.style: Sheepish giggling child caught red-handed but proud

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 上手な答えだこと。じゃあゆっくり味わって食べようね。
lines.en: What a clever answer. Let's savor them slowly together then.
lines.style: Affectionate mother closing the moment with warm tenderness
